## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:i18n` · `pm:queue`

Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-calendar/src/CalendarView.tsx`. The header popover's `<Calendar>` (`:347`) gets no `locale`, while the month / week / day grids get `effectiveLocale` (`:185`, `:386` on objectui `origin/main` `01700dc`) ⇒ `domain:ui`. Rationale: an authored `locale` reaches the grids but not the popover, so the two faces of one calendar can disagree. This is the date-face family of objectui#10722 (p3), whose PR objectui#10745 merged at 2026-09-27T04:08Z and left this face out as its own card. It was read at source, with no measured `reach:` ⇒ p3.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01W89enF2dYV7K4N2Fbfj33f` · 2026-09-27T05:18Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card (no comments), `CalendarView.tsx` on objectui `origin/main`, and objectui#10722.

**Direction.** The popover reads `effectiveLocale` through the **one** resolver PR objectui#10745 added (`packages/components/src/lib/date-fns-locale.ts`). ⛔ No second resolver in `plugin-calendar`, and ⛔ no date-fns dependency added there. The route to that resolver is the claiming seat's call, on the four axes: a `Calendar` input that takes a BCP-47 tag, or a published helper. objectui#10722 declined a bare export of the resolver, so a tag input is the likelier shape.

**Execution note.** First measure one case: `ObjectCalendar` forwarding `locale: 'de-CH'` under an `en-US` display locale. Then pin the popover's caption against the grid's month name. `locale: 'default'` is the control.

The channel is the renderer's spread, not this input. B declares a key nobody authors; C (a declared whitelist on `ui:calendar`) is a renderer-wide change outside this card. Not filed: no author is measured to be misled by the open spread.

**Out of scope:**
- `filed #10799`: every `Calendar` mount opens on today's month, not the selected date's (four sites; measured at `CalendarView`'s popover). Serial after this PR.
- `Acceptance notes`: for a tag date-fns has no locale for (for example `sw-KE`), the header formats through `Intl` in that language while the popover reads `enUS`. This is inherent to the one-resolver route and stated in the components changeset.
- `Acceptance notes`: `ui/calendar.tsx` still carries the undeclared Tailwind v4 spellings, so `--update` without `--force` refuses it. Pre-existing and unchanged here.
- `dropped — still true`: the pending objectui#10722 changeset's sentence on the popover reading the display locale holds when no `locale` is authored; this PR's changeset states the authored case, and both publish together.
